reviews.comment: Kind and smart person but completely unprepared prof. First two exams no one finished, but gave lots of partial and extra credit. ~biweekly homework that was unlike anything we learned in class, but he was pretty accessible by email for questions. 3 tests and a final, allowed lenient cheat sheets on all of them. Not terrible but wouldn't take again

I was struggling through this semester and he allowed me to make up for assignments and recover from bad grades I made due to health issues. I would've failed this course if it was most other professors, but Mr. Lee helped me. There's extra credit on every exam and if you put in the time this class is an easy A. He also responds to emails quickly.
